a.text: Administrator key cognition signal verified. Restoring...
Vital sign detection module activated. Automatically loading repair module. Repairing...

steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! I'm so relieved...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're finally awake.

options: How long have I been out?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The evacuation hasn't been smooth. Our neural link was abruptly severed, and it's hard to maintain stability due to the information impact at the boundaries.

options: What is my current condition, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just woke up myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry about me. I'm doing much better, thanks to Theresa's protection.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You should get a full check-up from Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good thing you never let go of my hand, or I would be even more worried.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't go off on your own, Doctor. We need to stay in the emergency observation area that Dr. Kal'tsit set up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Soon after we began, Dr. Kal'tsit cleared out an area that she is personally protecting, in order to ensure our safety and Rhodes Island's.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She didn't want any accidents to happen when we entered Civilight Eterna.

steps.name: Approaching Voice
steps.text: I started preparing cognition baseline tests as soon as I confirmed that you're awake.

steps.name: Approaching Voice
steps.text: Initial testing showed no obvious signs of damage for either of you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Diagnosing thought isn't quite as simple as diagnosing biological tissue, though. Further analysis will be required.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Welcome back, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A bit of distraction happened during your operation. I'll update you on the latest developments later.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The first priority is to make sure that you're safe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Establishing a neural link through the Black Crown is extremely risky. I take it you've long crossed the 'boundary'.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then, my first duty must be to ensure your cognitive stability and biological health.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't allow the mistakes of the past to be repeated, nor will I allow the continued existence of any potential threat to your life and safety.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Follow me, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You'll need to do the cognition baseline test too, Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: First, though, get some rest.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A-Alright, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's not part of my plans, Doctor. I'll arrange for Amiya to be tested as soon as your tests are complete.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's go.

options: I don't remember it at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A prototype that the Medical Department developed. Theresa and I designed it together.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But the limitations of our understanding of cognition and perception have prevented it from being put into service as a way to measure cognitive stability.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Under current circumstances, however, it's the most effective method available.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go inside the isolation pod, Doctor. Relax. I've tried it myself, and it won't cause any significant physical distress.

options: Anything else I need to know?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No. Just follow my instructions. I'll need to calibrate the machine first. Relax and do as I say, but do not hesitate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Tell me your name, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A good start.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Relax, Doctor. We're just calibrating.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: See the chronometer behind me? Count the time in silence and try to synchronize your counting with the ticking of its numbers.

options: (You silently count and feel the passage of time)
I'm not sure what the point of this is, Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It helps reinforce your perception of reality. It's been twenty seconds. Are you feeling any discomfort?

options: Is the machine showing something abnormal?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's continue the calibration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you able to continue to perceive Amiya in your consciousness?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Likely residue perception from the neural link being severed improperly.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good, we're getting used to the flow.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Continuing with the calibration. Do you agree with Rhodes Island's ideals?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good. We're almost done with the calibration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An interesting answer, Dr. {@nickname}, but this is not a lie detector. Unless you were expecting a more dramatic outcome.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Continue. You saw her at the cognitive boundary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As I expected. You're calmer than I thought you would be, though.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No need to hide it from me, Doctor. You can trust me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Final question. Do you have doubts about the one who is like you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A reasonable emotion, but I cannot resolve your doubts in any way or capacity. You will find the answer, sooner or later.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe you've already formed your subjective opinion. It's not my place to interfere with it, but I trust you will not act contrary to Rhodes Island's interests.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Looks like you've formed your opinion. I will not comment on it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're done, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Cognition baseline testing indicates that your cognitive stability remains within safe values. The rest of it is secondary.

options: Wait, I thought that was the calibration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was necessary to ensure that the data collected is accurate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I trust that you're capable of perceiving my thinking and camouflaging yourself accordingly.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would not be hard for you to fool this prototype.

options: ...Is this part of the test too, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The remaining checks will be complete soon, Dr. {@nickname}. I have time to answer a few questions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You understand, of course, that there are certain questions that I am not in a position to answer.

options: ...What are the origins of Rhodes Island?
How were you able to predict our movements ahead of time?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you're referring to this ship, it's even older than the history known to me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In a sense, it's the carrier of hope, hence the comprehensive protective systems capable of supporting our every operation on Terra.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is thanks to the initial design that it has survived the most brutal challenges with its core structure intact.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have yet to discover its full potential.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, I remain cautious about trying to unlock this potential in its entirety.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You mean the hints that were left behind at the boundary? There was no guarantee that it would be you who would solve them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nor am I able to predict things that have yet to come to pass. It was for another reason that I made such preparations...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Someone I respected very much had computed all the possibilities that could occur in the future. Someone whose words I will never forget.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps I have been quietly influenced too.

options: The current uncertainty is not the only reason why you're nervous.
I can't describe this strange intuition.
I've never sensed such complex emotions from you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not the one getting tested—
You see your reflection in the window, almost as though you were still standing with Kal'tsit.
You look at your own reflected image, but cannot help recalling the figure at the boundary, who treated the construct with such kindness...
Your gaze turns towards Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like this, Dr. {@nickname}?

options: Did you also put your utter trust in me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I still do. You've proven yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whatever you see at the boundary, Dr. {@nickname}, belongs to a past that is dead and gone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is enough that you and Rhodes Island are walking on the proper path. You and I, we both have the right to our subjective definition of this relationship that exists between us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You don't need to be concerned about how I view you, not before, not now, not ever. I respect your understanding of our cooperation—

options: I'm apologizing for my and Amiya's reckless actions.
I know what to do next.
I just have one more question, Kal'tsit.
(Unknown language) 'Perhaps it will be our blessing'...
(Unknown language) 'And the final gift of hope.'
I don't understand what it means.
I seem to sense good intentions behind the words.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It means 'blessing' and 'gift'.

options: You guided us to that one.
Whoever it was, there is nothing fake about your trust.
Then we have a lot of work to do.

steps.text: A regular-shaped Originium crystal emerges in the space.
A short curved line appears on the corner of the crystal.
Line expands into surface, then into a perfectly smooth sphere.
It is an eye that observes this dimension. All it does is record all that it sees; the organ that makes decisions has not fully escaped the Originium.
Until now.

steps.name: Originium Entity
steps.text: (Perceives silently)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit has determined that there is no major issue with me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But she was concerned about whether I was subject to any shock during the neural link.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We should get on with analyzing the formulas that you retrieved.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Like I said, the abnormalities of PRTS persist. It's very likely that we'll be getting even more anomalies in short order.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Closure has been trying, to little avail.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Deployment of the backup command system has begun, but it will take time to synchronize it across all equipment and individuals.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for the information you brought back from the boundary, I can help you decipher it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you understand its meaning?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll have to see the formulas in their entirety to be sure.
You and Amiya attempt to reconstruct the words and formulas written upon the glass of the corridor by memory, written in a language that you do not understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Based on the context, I believe I can fill in the blanks here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Largely accurate, but there are small errors here and there. Let me fix them.

options: It is like putting together a jigsaw puzzle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thankfully you were able to remember the last parts that I didn't have time to.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That should do.

options: Do you understand the meaning, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's a heretofore unnamed model, the origins of which may be traced to a project by the name of 'Slumber Bridge'.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was a radical project that attempted to employ a self-transcoding model in order to combine all possible realities and tangible, organic life into a single 'meta-reality'.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The project was ultimately a failure, but the experiments on digitizing matter were the predecessor to various subsequent research, including this model.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It has proven to be incredibly efficient at reducing the loss of meta-information during transmission through special mediums, and increasing data transmission efficiency.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now you're getting to the heart of the matter, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Originium is the medium used for information collection. It reformats the information and continues to propagate until its mission is accomplished.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This model, likely the one used by Originium itself, could lead to major breakthroughs in Originium research and Oripathy treatment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will decipher this information for classified archiving.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Until its risks and uses are ascertained, however, it must not appear in any blueprint or storage medium that exists in reality.

options: Can you get it done as soon as possible?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you have something in mind, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The project that Logos and Mechanist proposed after the war in Victoria?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Boosting the adaptability and combat ability of elite operators in high-Originium environments with the use of external equipment. A radical idea, and a difficult one to achieve.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The current version, developed two years ago, represents the limit of what we are able to achieve.

options: Now, we've discovered a new possibility.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's an excellent opportunity. At the very least, it will allow elite operators to deal with the Originium threat with greater ease.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will need your help in the decipherment process, Doctor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Thanks for the barrier. A life-saver.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Are you sure that Originium circuit has been properly set? I've checked it three times. It shouldn't fail...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: No semantical deviation. The circuit conforms to the simulations.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: There should not have been any error.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: How about another possibility... it's not we who are wrong?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: There are no flaws in the blueprint produced by the Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit. The incantation simulation is effective.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What I mean is that there's something wrong with the material used in the Originium Arc itself!

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I seem to remember that Closure kept some good stuff in the warehouse—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Bad idea. We've made enough of a mess in the Engineering Department as it is.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Well, we're doing it on the orders of the Doctor and Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But how do we validate its effectiveness?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Assuming that safety is assured, there is one ideal candidate for testing.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doesn't feel like there's been any real change in strength.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How about you go harder, kitten?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's not entirely up to me. Raidian?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: According to the statute of experiment, I can only increase the synchronization between the Originium Arc and Rosmontis in steps.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: It's not just to protect you, Blaze. It's to protect Rosmontis as well.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hehe, of course. I know.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I just wanted to test its limits as soon as possible, because Dr. Kal'tsit said this was urgent. How about you, kitten?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I can control it.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: No problem. I'll keep the risks in check.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Raidian, be ready to overwrite the Originium circuit at any moment and disconnect Rosmontis's control.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: ...Nothing keeps one on edge like working with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: How long will it take to finish the preparations, Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Assuming that the Doctor and I complete the decipherment as quickly as possible, and isolate a functional technical blueprint...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's cutting things too tight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are numerous key points in this technology that are virtually impossible for us to achieve.

options: The surest way to fail is to not try.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With the Black Crown, I should be able to help.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We must explore any avenue to gain an advantage for Rhodes Island. Perhaps it will make an impact in the not-so-distant future.
The Cautus feels like she has slept for a long time.
Her gaze is lost in the stars of deep space, but they offer no guidance as to where home is. She refuses to give up until she falls asleep from exhaustion.
Then, the light rouses her, and she opens her eyes.
There is no one around her.

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: (Unknown language) You are lost.

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: (Unknown language) It has been a long time since this place has seen a new visitor.

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: (Unknown language) Or are you the last survivor of the ruined planet?

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: The voice of Raydistorter? But why—

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: (Unknown language) In any case, welcome.

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: (Unknown language) Come. Seek me.
She remembers this scene. She should have died after disintegrating, but light rushed into her eyes again.
She came to this place, the domain of the gods... it all happened again.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: H-How could this be?
She looks out of the porthole in terror, and sees the dead planet.
Roaming through the ship, she encounters that being by the name of Raydistorter once again, and the Presence that gazes upon death, alone in deep space...
Every trace that she was ever here has disappeared.

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: No... no... no...

steps.name: Hierda
steps.text: Am I still dreaming?

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: This is not a dream.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: But it's not reality either.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: You were looking for me, weren't you?
The Cautus sees a hand reach towards her and take hers—
Like the hand that held hers when she disintegrated.
She saw 'God'.
